correctness.rationale: For positive \(\sigma_{11}\) and \(\sigma_{12}\), every factor in the printed density except the zero-end power tends to a finite positive constant at zero, so local integrability holds exactly when \(-2+2r/\sigma_{11}^2>-1\), equivalently \(r>\sigma_{11}^2/2\). At infinity the two polynomial exponents sum to \(-4\) and the exponential tends to one, so the tail is integrable. The threshold \(R_0^E\) and Theorem 4.2 explicitly use this density. The exact-rational checker confirms the endpoint-exponent identities and a critical nonnormalizable witness.
